content.what_it_is: Preprocessor-expanded (cpp output, leading blank lines L1-10) FUNWAVE-TVD bc.F for a PARALLEL non-CARTESIAN build, found under funwave-work/build/pre/. Four subroutines. (1) BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L63-193): on ranks with MPI_PROC_NULL neighbors imposes wall conditions on the four edges -- west skipped for ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR wavemakers (L73), otherwise P=0 and Fx=0.5_SP*GRAV*(Xi*Xi*Gamma3+2.0_SP*Xi*Deps) with Xi=EtaRxR, Deps=Depthx (L76-82); east analogue with EtaRxL at Iend1 (L90-96); south/north Q=Fy=0 and Gy wall flux unless PERIODIC (L101-126); then dry-cell (MASK<1) flux zeroing/wall closure over Jbeg-1..Jend+1, Ibeg-1..Iend+1 (L135-191) using the 'new splitting method' Xi/Deps forms multiplied by neighbor MASK (L143-145, L156-158, L170-172, L183-185), with Jeff Harris' inter-processor guards (I/=Ibeg).or.(n_west.ne.MPI_PROC_NULL) etc. (L140, L153, L167, L180) and his ghost-cell caveat comment (L129-133). (2) EXCHANGE_DISPERSION (L205-282): PHI_COLL ghost fills for dispersion arrays Uxx/DUxx (VTYPE=2), Vyy/DVyy (3), cross terms Uxy/DUxy/Vxy/DVxy (1) (L210-221); when Gamma2>ZERO also the time-derivative set -- ETAT/ETATx/ETATy if DISP_TIME_LEFT else Ut..DVtxy (L223-261) -- and first-derivative set Ux..ETAy (L263-277). Unlike the GPU port (exchange_gpu0819.F), ETATx/ETATy are exchanged (L229-231) and the whole block is not CARTESIAN-conditional. (3) EXCHANGE (L294-344): PHI_COLL for Eta (L301), radiation-stress fields Wsurf/P_center/Q_center/U_davg/V_davg (L304-308), AGE_BREAKING and nu_break under breaking flags (L310-317), P/Q via PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH under viscosity/diffusion flags (L319-322), MASK via real copy rMASK (L324-326), U/HU (VTYPE=2) and V/HV (3) (L328-333), then masks velocities U/V/HU/HV *= MASK (L338-341). (4) PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH (L354-414): simple 4-side mirror ghost fill for staggered arrays on MPI_PROC_NULL sides, west skipped for ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR (L369). (5) PHI_COLL (L427-783): generic ghost fill; declarations incl. req, status(MPI_STATUS_SIZE,1), staging xx/send2d(Mloc,Nghost), unused myvar/mybeta (L438-442). PERIODIC y-wrap first (L445-510): for PY>1, per processor-column II pairwise MPI_SEND/MPI_IRECV+MPI_WAITALL between ProcessorID(II,1) and ProcessorID(II,PY) exchanging Nghost rows (L451-496); for PY=1 an in-place wrap over I=Ibeg..Iend (L499-504). Then VTYPE dispatch on MPI_PROC_NULL sides: 1 eta symmetric mirror (L518-560 area); 2 u x-antisymmetric, y symmetric (from L563); 3 v x-symmetric, y antisymmetric (from L616); 4 cross-derivative zeroing PHI=ZERO (L665-698 area, comment 'not an exact solution'); 5 fully symmetric (L701-737); 6 fully anti-symmetric (L739-778); finally call phi_exch(PHI) for inter-rank halo exchange (L781). West-side fills are skipped for ABS/LEFT_BC_IRR wavemakers in VTYPE 1-3 (L523, L563 area, L621 area). No file I/O; data blocks: none.
entities: SUBROUTINE BOUNDARY_CONDITION @L63; USE GLOBAL @L64; REAL(SP)::Xi,Deps @L66; end @L193
SUBROUTINE EXCHANGE @L294; INTEGER :: VTYPE @L297; REAL(SP),DIMENSION(Mloc,Nloc) :: rMASK @L298; end @L344

SUBROUTINE PHI_COLL_VARIABLE_LENGTH(Mloc,Nloc,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,Nghost,PHI,VTYPE) @L354; USE PARAM @L356; USE GLOBAL ONLY WaveMaker @L357; USE GLOBAL ONLY n_east,n_west,n_suth,n_nrth @L359; VTYPE @L362; dims @L363; PHI INOUT @L364; end @L414

SUBROUTINE PHI_COLL(Mloc,Nloc,Ibeg,Iend,Jbeg,Jend,Nghost,PHI,VTYPE,PERIODIC) @L427; USE GLOBAL imports incl. comm2d,ier,myid,PX,PY,NumberProcessor,ProcessorID @L430-432; VTYPE @L434; dims @L435; PHI @L436; LOGICAL PERIODIC @L437; INTEGER,DIMENSION(1) :: req @L438; nreq,len,ll,l,II,JJ @L439; status(MPI_STATUS_SIZE,1) @L440; xx,send2d(Mloc,Nghost) @L441; myvar,mybeta @L442; end @L783

verbatim_spans.text: ! Jeff pointed out the loop should be Jbeg-1, Jend+1
! etaR x mask is a wrong idea
rMASK = MASK ! for periodic boundary condition

unresolved: This is generated cpp output (build/pre/) of bc.F with PARALLEL active and CARTESIAN apparently off (PERIODIC handled at runtime, no DX scalar branches remain) -- flag set of the originating build is not recorded in the file (stray comments '! end cartesian' L512, '! end parallel' L508 are residue of stripped preprocessor blocks).

MASK (integer array in GLOBAL) is ghost-exchanged through a REAL copy rMASK (L324-326) because PHI_COLL only accepts REAL(SP) -- implicit real-to-int truncation on assignment back; relation L298 vs L324-326.

PHI_COLL declares nreq,ll,l,JJ,myvar,mybeta (L439, L442) that are never used; the periodic exchange serializes MPI_SEND before posting the matching MPI_IRECV on the peer (L453-494) -- correct only while messages fit MPI's eager buffering.

PHI_COLL's PY=1 in-place periodic wrap copies over I=Ibeg..Iend only (L499-504) while the PY>1 path exchanges full Mloc rows including x-ghosts (L454, L468) -- corner ghost handling differs between the two paths.

Compared with the GPU port (FUNWAVE-GPU/src/exchange_gpu0819.F): here EXCHANGE_DISPERSION exchanges ETATx/ETATy (L229-231) which the GPU version comments out; EXCHANGE additionally exchanges radiation-stress fields Wsurf/P_center/Q_center/U_davg/V_davg (L304-308) absent there; loop indices I,J,K are GLOBAL module variables (no local declarations despite IMPLICIT NONE in each routine).
phi_exch (L781) is defined elsewhere (MPI halo exchange); VTYPE=4 y-direction zeroing carries the comment 'this one is not an exact solution' (chunk3, before the VTYPE=4 south block).
